candidates.question: Imagine you're developing a web application for a major e-commerce platform. As a result, you decide to implement TCP congestion control to manage network traffic effectively. Your task is to explain how TCP congestion control uses slow start and congestion avoidance to prevent overloading the server.
candidates.answer_key: Slow Start is a phase where TCP increases the number of packets it sends in each round trip progressively. It starts by sending just one packet and then doubles the number of packets sent in each subsequent round trip until it reaches a certain threshold. This helps in gradually building up congestion window size without overwhelming the network. Congestion Avoidance, on the other hand, is a phase where TCP increases the size of the congestion window more slowly. It doubles the congestion window size for every round trip in which no packets are lost, allowing the network to reach a higher bandwidth without suffering packet loss. By combining these two phases, TCP congestion control efficiently manages network congestion, ensuring smooth and reliable data transmission.
